roles.subject: Application: Forward Deployed Engineer, EMEA
roles.body:
Dear Capably hiring team,

I am applying for the Forward Deployed Engineer, EMEA role in Madrid. I have spent the last three years as the person who sits between a customer's real workflow and a working system, and that is the job this role describes.

At FlowSpace, I took over a live workspace marketplace and drove its migration off a legacy stack onto Next.js and Laravel while the product stayed live, mapping the old structure entity by entity and choosing the migration path (API or CSV) for each one. The platform grew from 2,000 to 4,500+ users through that period. I also built and own an AI listing bot that turns a provider's brochure, in any format, into a drafted listing with a human in the loop, and support AI agents that answer customer queries from live platform data and escalate to a person when confidence is low.

At Urlink, I worked as project manager and AI-assisted developer for a client in Barcelona: gathering the client's actual requirements, building the platform and its logic, and implementing the automations the client needed on top of it. That combination, translating a client's operational reality into a working system and owning the build end to end, is the same shape of work Capably is describing for deployment.

My stack includes TypeScript, Next.js, Laravel, Supabase, n8n and LLM API integrations. I hold Italian EU long-term resident status, which gives me current work authorisation in Italy; a role in Spain would need the applicable employer-side permit or sponsorship process, which I am ready to start, and I am open to being based in Madrid.

I am available immediately and would welcome the chance to talk through how I could help Capably increase deployment capacity.

Regards,
Prabhavit Gupta

I would welcome the chance to talk through how I would approach encoding a first use case end to end.
